SpoOOOoky...|Beginning of Wave 55}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gravekeeper''' was considered to be the first major boss of the game to appear. It was the final enemy that appeared in Easy mode. The '''Gravekeeper''' would later be removed, and, replaced with the [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]] in [[Release v1.0]]. The '''Gravekeeper''' walked slower than the [[Slow Boss]] but had far higher health compared to the [[Slow Boss]]. It could spawn 4-8 [[Tombstone]]s which needed to be destroyed. These [[Tombstone]]s could have spawned [[Normal]]s, [[Slow]]s, [[Hidden]]s and [[Normal Boss]]es. It also had the ability to smash its hammer into the ground, creating a shockwave which stunned nearby towers. ==Appearance== The '''Gravekeeper''' had green skin, a grey torso, wore a grey cloak with sleeves and had dark green legs. The '''Gravekeeper''' also had a chain wrapped around its torso, a black hood, and one red eye (the other was covered by an eye patch). The '''Gravekeeper''' also wielded a giant rusty hammer and had a [[Tombstone]] on its back. ==Strategy== * The [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Drop'' ability can handle the two '''Gravekeepers''' that spawn on wave 55. *[[Commander]]s can be used to boost high DPS towers such as the [[Minigunner]] and [[Turret]]. *Towers near the path are vulnerable to the ''Hammer Smash''. Try to locate towers away from the path, if possible. *The [[Tombstone]]s the '''Gravekeeper''' spawns may cause a problem if no towers can reach them. Locate a tower near them, or rely on [[Military Base]] [[units]] or crooks from the [[Crook Boss]] to clear them up. *Multiple [[Ranger|Outlaws]] can be used against this as it has long range and high damage. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Abilities |- |[[File:GravekeeperSmash.ogg]] |'''Smash''' ability |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:GravekeeperScream.ogg]] |'''Gravekeeper''' death |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} Gravekeeper.png|'''Gravekeeper''' on a render. }} ==Trivia== *There was a glitch where you could place a tower on the body of the '''Gravekeeper''' when it was killed, allowing for more towers to be placed on maps like [[Doomspire]] where placement space was limited. *As with the other major bosses at the time, towers will fire on the '''Gravekeeper''' for a few seconds after its death. *The eyepatch used by the '''Gravekeeper''' is the {{RLinkC|74970669|Eyepatch}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''10 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.4|BETA v1.4.0]] **'''Gravekeeper''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **'''Gravekeeper''' removed, replaced with [[Grave Digger (Legacy)|Grave Digger]]. {{Easy|[[Super Mystery|Mystery 2]]|Wave 32|Gravekeeper & [[Mystery Summoner|Mystery Boss]]|Wave 35 (End of Easy Mode)|[[Boomer 1]]|Wave 36}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
